title: excoecaria laurocerasus var. laurifolia
intro: Excoecaria laurocerasus var. laurifolia, commonly known as the poison tree, is a plant species within the family Euphorbiaceae. It is used for its medicinal properties, which include its ability to treat fever, inflammation, and skin conditions due to its health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Excoecaria laurocerasus var. laurifolia include its anti-inflammatory, antipyretic, and antiseptic properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant are primarily composed of triterpenoids, flavonoids, and alkaloids, which contribute to its medicinal effects.
